summary: St. Joe National Forest lookout in Shoshone County, Idaho: pole tower from 1922, replaced 1927 and 1952, destroyed 1979; no source describes what remains.

facts.design: successive towers: 50-foot pole with cab (1922), 45-foot steel windmill (1927), 53-foot treated timber L-4 (1952)
facts.status_note: Listed as tower gone after its 1979 destruction. No source we read describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as drive-up.

events.note: 50-foot pole tower with 7x7 cab and a ground cabin
45-foot steel windmill tower with 6x6 cab. firelookout.com gives 1927; Forest Lookouts gives c.1927, so the story says around 1927
53-foot treated timber tower with L-4 cab
Destroyed; sources 1-3 give 1979. Source 4 lists the tower as gone with no year. No cause given

notes_for_editor: Tower history agrees across sources 1-3, except the 1927 windmill date: firelookout.com gives 1927 and Forest Lookouts gives c.1927, so the story says around 1927. Source 4 lists the tower as gone with no year.Not to be confused with the Round Top lookouts in Clearwater National Forest (Idaho County, 1934 to 1972) or the Round Top Mountain in Bonner County; those are different sites and were not used. height_m is converted from the final 53-foot tower. No source gives a cause for the 1979 destruction, and no source describes the site today.
